premises.text: Outdated car technology necessitates a solution for over 1 billion vehicles on the road
premises.evidence_span: Aren't you frustrated by how outdated the technology in your car is? And even if you have some cool technology in your car, aren't you afraid that a year from now, this technology will be completely outdated, and the only way to change that is to buy a new car?

premises.text: Vinly can make cars manufactured after 1996 smarter than new cars
premises.evidence_span: Vinly is a connected car platform that enables building applications and services for your car. It can make a car manufactured after 1996, which is almost every car on the road right now smarter than a car that just left the assembly line.

premises.text: The Vinly device connects and communicates with cars easily
premises.evidence_span: The device plugs into your car under the dash. Don't worry. It's as easy as plugging a USB device into your computer.

premises.text: Vinly offers a variety of apps for safety, diagnostics, and entertainment
premises.evidence_span: We already built a number of apps on the platform so consumers can use Vinly from day one. Build some apps for safety.

premises.text: Vinly provides a comprehensive platform for developers to create applications for connected cars
premises.evidence_span: With Vinly, we had the developers as our center point and our focus right from the start.

premises.text: The connected car market is a significant opportunity for developers
premises.evidence_span: The connected car market is a $131 billion industry.

value.text: Consumers and developers benefit from enhanced car technology and applications
value.evidence_span: Vinly is the first true technology platform for the car.

notes: Traction metrics and fundraising details excluded as they do not support premises.
